course.title: CUET (Humanities)
course.description:
The complete CUET UG 2026 syllabus will be covered in this batch.
 

  1. Subjects included: History, Geography, Political Sc., Economics, General Aptitude Test, and English/HIndi.
     
  2. Live lectures will be conducted in Hinglish for better understanding.
     
  3. Classes will be held 6 days a week, with each session lasting 1.5 hours.
     
  4. PDF notes for every class will be provided on the Next Toppers App.
  5. Scheduled tests will be conducted as per the planner.
  6. Practice Mock Papers will be provided every Sunday.
  7. Hindi/GK will be provided in recorded format, so you can study at your own convenience.
     
  8. The course will remain accessible to students until the CUET 2026 exam.
     
  9. Classes start from 1st April 2026, syllabus completion by 10th May 2026, and batch validity till 30th June 2026.
